versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the "monitoring-vc-investor-activity-on-twitter" skill.
- Monitors VC investor activity and deal signals on Twitter/X using apidojo's Tweet scraper.
- Supports advanced filtering by keywords, user type, date, engagement metrics, media, and location.
- Outputs investor handle, firm, investment thesis signals, recent activity, and deal flow indicators.
- Classifies and scores results by investment activity and relevance for founders, co-investors, and analysts.
